name: What should I do immediately if I discover water coming up through my floor?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately if I discover water coming up through my floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: First, ensure your safety by turning off the main water supply to your home and, if safe, cutting power to affected areas to prevent electrical hazards. Then, contact a professional restoration company immediately. Avoid walking through standing water unnecessarily. Do not attempt to use a wet/dry vacuum or other equipment near live electricity. Quick action can significantly reduce damage and mold growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: Turn off your main water supply and power to affected areas, then call a professional restoration company immediately.
